name: Chef Curated: adding and removing a recipe card from favorites toggles the heart icon and shows the matching toast
statusMessage: Skipped: Flaky: Chef Curated renders cards from cached data, then GET /api/v1/curated_recipes lands 2-4s later and redraws them; a heart toggled before it lands reverts in the UI while the server keeps the change (reproduced 3/8 locally). redirect_to_chef_curated returns before that refetch. Re-enable once navigation waits for the list refetch in every case - it is not issued on every visit, so a response wait alone hangs - and the fix is validated against a stable staging.
